canDoYue: 你識講對花生敏感、唔食豬肉、蛋冇問題、炒飯有花生油、改素麵、分開鑊，同埋叫店員寫低張單。
canDoEn: Say you are allergic to peanuts and do not eat pork, say egg is fine, avoid fried rice with peanut oil, take vegetarian noodles from a separate pan, and ask for a note on the order.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Hello, I'm allergic to peanuts, and I don't eat pork during this whole dinner order.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好，我對花生敏感，呢餐晚餐我唔食豬肉。
dialogue.say: Hello, I'm allergic to peanuts, and I don't eat pork during this whole dinner order.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Okay. Is egg also a serious problem, even sitting on top of that peanut allergy?
dialogue.glossYue: 好。除咗花生敏感，蛋係咪都有問題？
dialogue.say: Okay. Is egg also a serious problem, even sitting on top of that peanut allergy?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: No, egg is completely fine. Does the hot fried rice have peanuts inside it too?
dialogue.glossYue: 蛋完全冇問題。熱炒飯入面有冇花生？
dialogue.say: No, egg is completely fine. Does the hot fried rice have peanuts inside it too?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Yes, that rice has peanut oil in the pan. I'd suggest vegetarian noodles instead though.
dialogue.glossYue: 有，嗰碟飯鑊入面有花生油。我建議改素麵。
dialogue.say: Yes, that rice has peanut oil in the pan. I'd suggest vegetarian noodles instead though.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Do those hot vegetarian noodles have any pork hidden inside them during the dinner rush?
dialogue.glossYue: 熱素麵入面會唔會喺繁忙時段藏咗豬肉？
dialogue.say: Do those hot vegetarian noodles have any pork hidden inside them during the dinner rush?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: No, they're fully vegetarian. I'll ask the kitchen staff to use one separate clean pan.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔會，完全素。我會叫廚房用一個乾淨嘅分開鑊。
dialogue.say: No, they're fully vegetarian. I'll ask the kitchen staff to use one separate clean pan.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Thank you very much. Please tell the head chef that I am allergic to peanuts.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。請同主廚講我對花生敏感。
dialogue.say: Thank you very much. Please tell the head chef that I am allergic to peanuts.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: I will do that. I'll put a clear written note on your dinner order slip.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會。我會喺你張晚餐單上面寫清楚。
dialogue.say: I will do that. I'll put a clear written note on your dinner order slip.
